A test scans every such route for the factory POST and for the 501 helper.

DEF-0B8-FED-EXTERNAL-UPLOAD-ATTACHES-ANY.explanation: An upload names a stored object only if no document, and no version of one, in the organization already holds it; an object another record holds answers 409 and inserts nothing. Tests added for both holders.
DEF-0B8-FED-EXTERNAL-UPLOAD-ATTACHES-ANY.remaining: An unattached object under the organization prefix is still accepted: nothing yet proves it was uploaded by this representative for this matter (an upload-intake record bound to the representative is needed).

DEF-0B10-PIL-REFERENCE-PROFILE-PRESENTS-.explanation: The profile states no default testimonial, no six-hour floor and no 90-day outcomes: a quote appears only when supplied and always as unattested, time saved is null, the case study lists outcomes only when a stored metrics row exists, and the data source is labelled.

DEF-0B7-COGB-PRECEDENT-AND-PROCEDURAL-EN.explanation: The precedent and procedural engines refuse with NOT_IMPLEMENTED for every organization and return no constant profile (existing implementation and test).

DEF-0B7-COGA-FORECAST-PROJECTIONS-ARE-FI.explanation: The continuity forecast reports no trend and no projection instead of an improving curve from fixed rates, and bases its metrics on eligible interviews, proven against a real SQL engine (existing implementation and test).

DEF-0B8-JUR-LOCATION-TRACK-WRITES-ARE-UN.explanation: The position insert and an audit record (purpose, strike or event, never the coordinates) commit in one transaction; a member who has not opted in gets 403, a disabled tracker 503, and any other failure a 500 without internal text. Test mocks extended for the new collaborators; three new route tests.

DEF-0B8-JUR-INVESTIGATIONS-PATH-IS-THE-C.explanation: The investigations path was an alias of the case collection (a create made a case); it answers 501 and the roster-facade ratchet pins it.

DEF-0B8-JUR-INVESTIGATIONS-AUDIT-PATH-RE.explanation: The investigation audit path no longer returns the organization audit log under another name; it answers 501.

DEF-0B8-JUR-ALIAS-WRAPPERS-CARRY-AN-ALWA.explanation: The two investigation aliases lost their always-true guard along with their delegation.
DEF-0B8-JUR-ALIAS-WRAPPERS-CARRY-AN-ALWA.remaining: Other wrappers (governance, intelligence, the oci paths and the communications tracking handlers) still carry a requireOrgAccess that returns true for every request.

DEF-0B4-CLAUSES-ITEM-GET-WRITES-VIEW-COU.explanation: Reading a clause by id writes nothing. Test adapted from countView true to false; the clause view counter is no longer incremented by a read.

DEF-0B10-PEN-PENSION-LIST-READS-HAVE-NO-.explanation: The six pension list reads take bounded limit (1..200, default 200 so existing callers are unchanged) and offset (0..1,000,000) through the shared listPage helper, so rows beyond the first page are reachable. The own-records route test mock and the B36 bounds pin were adapted to the offset call (disclosed).

DEF-0B4-CBAS-LIST-LIMIT-UNBOUNDED.explanation: The agreement list refuses a page outside 1..10000 or a limit outside 1..100 with 400 instead of passing an unparsed number to the query.

DEF-0B4-CBAS-DETAIL-GET-WRITES-VIEW-COUN.explanation: Reading one agreement counts no view, whatever the include flags; the view counter is no longer incremented by a read.

DEF-0B6-CMP-COMPLIANCE-LISTS-UNBOUNDED.explanation: The alert and report lists return at most 500 rows (the failure answer was fixed in B33).

DEF-0B6-SYS-CONTACT-UNBOUNDED-FIELDS-AND.explanation: Every contact field has a length bound (name 100, address 254, organization 200, role and inquiry type 100) and the visitor's address is no longer written to the log; tests cover an oversized field and the log content.

DEF-0B11-PRP-PRECEDENT-COLLECTION-GET-TA.explanation: The precedent collection refuses an invalid page or a limit above 100 with 400 (existing implementation and tests).

DEF-0B11-PRP-REDEMPTIONS-GET-IGNORES-THE.explanation: The status filter reaches the query (and its total), and the accepted values are the six the redemption status can hold, including the ones a redemption starts in. Two existing assertions adapted for the added argument; new tests cover a valid and an invalid status.

DEF-0B12-PLT-VOICE-TRANSCRIBE-RETURNS-TH.explanation: The transcription response carries no duration: neither bytes nor a guess is reported as a measured audio duration (existing implementation and test).

DEF-0B6-EDU-COMPLETIONS-ROUTE-NOT-FILTER.explanation: The completions list reads only completed registrations of the caller's organization.

DEF-0B6-SYS-DEPRECATION-REGISTRY-NAMES-M.explanation: Seven registry rows named replacement routes that do not exist; they now name the real route (current-user, message thread, strike funds) or REMOVED with the reason. A test checks every named replacement against the route tree. A sunset date already past is no longer advertised in a Sunset header, and the body states that it has passed.

DEF-0B4-CHATBOT-SESSION-READ-IGNORES-STA.explanation: The session list reads active sessions only, and the message read needs the entitlement, the AI feature flag, the safety check and the rate limit, and refuses an archived or deleted session (existing implementation and test).

DEF-0B2-AI-FINANCE-ROLE-TITLE-GATE.explanation: The finance analysis and the three pension intelligence routes first require a live finance:view mandate (in the caller own tenant context) and answer 403 without it, before the rate limit, feature gate, entitlement or any read. The finance analysis test mock gained the new collaborator and a refusal test.
DEF-0B2-AI-FINANCE-ROLE-TITLE-GATE.remaining: The view mandate is not resource-scoped to a plan or member, and the pension projection still reads any member of the plan by id for an officer.

DEF-0B6-EMP-COMPLIANCE-EVENT-FORGEABLE-B.explanation: Raising a compliance event is a financial-role act; a manual flag may be info or warning only, can never block an approval, cannot take an engine event code (it is prefixed manual_), and its summary and code are bounded; unknown body fields are refused.

DEF-0B6-EMP-EXECUTION-READS-AT-MEMBER-FL.explanation: The compliance event list moves from the member floor to the financial roles and is bounded to 500 rows; the payroll and remittance run lists already require the financial roles and a live view mandate.

DEF-0B11-PRP-WALLET-GET-READS-BALANCE-AN.explanation: getWalletSnapshot reads the latest balance, the page and the total inside one repeatable-read transaction, so they cannot disagree; the response also carries the total and hasMore is computed from it. Proved on PostgreSQL (PGlite) for paging, scoping to the member and organization, and an empty ledger. The route test mock now returns the snapshot (disclosed).

DEF-0B11-PRP-REWARDS-EXPORT-IS-UNBOUNDED.explanation: The export needs the administrator role before any read, is bounded to 5,000 rows, neutralises spreadsheet formula cells, and is audited in the transaction that reads it so a failed audit withholds the file (existing implementation and test).

DEF-0B4-CBA-INGESTION-FETCHES-UNRESTRICT.explanation: A shared guard refuses non-http(s) schemes, credentials in the address, localhost and internal names, private, loopback, link-local, metadata and reserved IPv4 and IPv6 literals (including IPv4-mapped forms). The base adapter checks every address before fetching, follows redirects by hand (three at most) re-checking each hop, and refuses a source larger than 10 million characters; every ingestion adapter fetches through it, and a source address is checked when it is saved.
DEF-0B4-CBA-INGESTION-FETCHES-UNRESTRICT.remaining: The guard reads the address as written and does not resolve DNS, so a public name that resolves to a private address is not caught; that needs an egress policy or a resolving fetch. The body is still read whole before the size check.

DEF-0B7-EXC-INDEX-FAILURE-RETURNS-200-WI.explanation: A failed indexing now returns a result flagged failed with the fixed text "Indexing failed" (the error stays in the audit record), and the index route answers it 500 instead of 200 carrying the error. Two existing indexer assertions adapted: they required the raw error text ("audit down", "embed boom") in the reason, which is the defect; they now require the fixed text and the absence of the error text.

DEF-0B7-COGB-PROPAGATION-UNKNOWN-NODE-AN.explanation: The query is validated (nodeId bounded text, analysisType one of four values, unknown parameters refused), an unknown node answers 404 instead of a thrown 500. Verified and completed: an unknown node is a 404, the query is a strict schema, and each analysis type, node view included, returns only its own section.

DEF-0B12-PLT-WORKSPACE-TELEMETRY-LOGS-UN.explanation: The telemetry body is bounded to 2 KB while it is streamed (not only by Content-Length), the payload is reduced to an allow-list of canonical event, tab and static route, and the client attests to no timestamp or workspace name (existing implementation and tests).
DEF-0B12-PLT-WORKSPACE-TELEMETRY-LOGS-UN.remaining: The route has no rate limit of its own beyond the member floor.

DEF-0B10-PIL-PILOT-FEEDBACK-COMMENT-IS-U.explanation: The comment must be text of at most 2000 characters (trimmed; an empty one is stored as none), a body that is not a JSON object is refused, and the administrator summary no longer returns the author user id of recent feedback. New route test covers each.

DEF-0B10-PIL-PILOT-WRITE-ROUTES-CAST-THE.explanation: The pilot events and feedback writes bound their free-form fields (session id 200 characters, metadata a plain object of at most 4 KB, comment 2000 characters) and refuse a body that is not a JSON object; tests added for each bound.
DEF-0B10-PIL-PILOT-WRITE-ROUTES-CAST-THE.remaining: The other pilot write routes (apply, onboarding, demo data) still cast their JSON body without a schema, and the event type stays caller-asserted.

DEF-0B11-SOC-SIGNATURE-PATCH-DECLARES-A-.explanation: The void PATCH now applies its schema: a strict body with the literal action void and a trimmed reason of 1 to 1000 characters. A body that does not match is a 400 and nothing is stored. Contract test added.

DEF-0B11-SOC-SIGNATURE-LIST-IS-UNPAGINAT.explanation: Both queries of the caller own document list (sent and to-sign) are limited to 200 rows, newest first, and the to-sign side returns only the caller own signer row. Contract test pins both limits.
DEF-0B11-SOC-SIGNATURE-LIST-IS-UNPAGINAT.remaining: No cursor or offset parameter yet; the newest 200 are returned.

DEF-0B11-SOC-SIGNATURE-STATUS-AND-AUDIT-.explanation: The status, the audit trail and the audit report keep every signer network address, user agent and geolocation for the sender only. A signer sees those fields only on the rows that describe themselves. Unit tests cover sender, signer and audit rows. The audit route test mock gained getDocumentSender (disclosed adaptation).
DEF-0B11-SOC-SIGNATURE-STATUS-AND-AUDIT-.remaining: Signer e-mail addresses are still visible to every signer, and the report actor and signer rows carry no user id, so a signer own network data is also withheld from the report.

DEF-0B11-SOC-SIGNATURE-AUDIT-TRAIL-HAS-N.explanation: The audit report no longer reads as certified evidence: it carries an integrity block stating the trail is unsealed, not hash-chained and not tamper-evident.
DEF-0B11-SOC-SIGNATURE-AUDIT-TRAIL-HAS-N.remaining: No hash chain, file-hash recomputation at signing, or sealing is implemented, and the signer address still comes from a client-supplied forwarded header.

DEF-0B9-ORG-DIRECTORY-SEARCH-UNESCAPED-W.explanation: The search term is trimmed, bounded to 100 characters (400 beyond), and its LIKE wildcards are taken literally. Results are ordered by name then id and paged by limit (at most 50) and offset. The test mock chain was adapted to the ordered, paged query (disclosed), and a new test covers escaping, bounds and offset.

DEF-0B12-PLT-KPI-ITEM-ID-IS-NOT-VALIDATE.explanation: Existing implementation, verified: a malformed target id is a 400 before any database predicate is built, with an existing test that no query or audit happens.
DEF-0B12-PLT-KPI-ITEM-ID-IS-NOT-VALIDATE.remaining: The route still offers no edit, rename or delete of a target.

DEF-0B4-CLAUSE-LIBRARY-BODY-FIELDS-UNVAL.explanation: Clause create, update and sharing bodies pass a zod schema before anything is stored: text, titles and names are bounded, dates are real calendar days, province is a 2-letter code, ids are ids, sharing levels are the four known ones, grants are at most 200 ids, and unknown fields are dropped. A malformed body is a 400. Existing route tests were adapted: organization and agreement fixtures that were not ids became ids, and handler calls that publish publicly carry an officer role (disclosed).
DEF-0B4-CLAUSE-LIBRARY-BODY-FIELDS-UNVAL.remaining: The tag write route still reads its body without the schema.

DEF-0B4-CLAUSE-LIBRARY-PUBLISHING-ON-STE.explanation: Setting a clause to public sharing on create, update or the share route now requires an officer role; a steward, a member or an unresolved role is refused with 403 before any read or write. Narrower scopes stay with the owning steward and keep their federation and congress eligibility checks.
DEF-0B4-CLAUSE-LIBRARY-PUBLISHING-ON-STE.remaining: The floor is a role title; no mandate-kernel decision names who may publish collective-agreement text.

DEF-0B4-CLAUSE-LIBRARY-ORIGINAL-CLAUSE-I.explanation: A cited originalClauseId must be a clause of a collective agreement of the caller own organization (joined through the agreement); a missing or foreign one is a 404 and nothing is inserted. The id must also be well-formed.

DEF-0B4-CLAUSE-LIBRARY-COMPARE-WRITES-OT.explanation: A comparison no longer increments comparisonCount on rows another organization owns: it is a read of those rows and writes only the usage counter of the caller own clauses. The audit stays with the comparing organization.

DEF-0B8-ICRA-ONE-SHOT-SUBMIT-STORES-CLIE.explanation: The one-shot submit builds the stored consent on the server from the three acknowledgements (time and doctrine version stamped here; client time, version and extra keys dropped), accepts only the en-CA and fr-CA locales, reads the body as text under a 64 KB cap (413 beyond), and refuses organization-context keys that are not short lower-case identifiers or exceed 40. Unit and source-contract tests added; existing route tests still pass.

DEF-0B8-ICRA-STEPWISE-FLOW-NEVER-REQUIRE.explanation: The stepwise flow requires all three acknowledgements to start (400 otherwise, consent stamped by the server), the answer route refuses to store anything for an assessment with no recorded consent (409), and so does the stepwise submit. No application caller of these routes existed. Existing tests were adapted: assessment fixtures now carry a recorded consent, the start 500 test sends consent, and the submit tests mock the coverage helper (disclosed); new tests cover the refusals.

DEF-0B8-ICRA-STEPWISE-SUBMIT-SCORES-ANY-.explanation: The stepwise submit scores nothing unless every question the routing engine requires for an unclassified organization has an answer (400 with the missing count otherwise), using the same routed-submission validator as the live flow. Proven against the real question bank: one answer is refused, a full set is accepted.

DEF-0B7-COGA-ROADMAP-DOCUMENTATION-STRAT.explanation: The documentation strategy is selected when the documentation score is low (under 65) or unmeasured (missing or not finite), and not for any high score. The expression that parsed as score ?? (0 < 65) is gone. Source-contract test added.

DEF-0B7-COGB-ROADMAP-DOCUMENTATION-RULE-.explanation: The precedence defect in the documentation rule is corrected (same fix as the companion defect).
DEF-0B7-COGB-ROADMAP-DOCUMENTATION-RULE-.remaining: The projected resilience, governance and dependency gains of each strategy are still literal numbers from a per-strategy table.

DEF-0B7-COGB-PERSONALITY-LABEL-ASSIGNED-.explanation: With fewer than two entries and sessions the profiler now returns a new insufficient_data type with no characteristics and an identity statement that says so, instead of Resilience-Fragile. The existing no-history test pinned the old label and was changed to assert the new behaviour (disclosed).

DEF-0B7-COGB-INTERVIEW-READS-UNBOUNDED.explanation: Every derived analysis that read all published exit interviews now reads at most 500, newest as the database returns them, through one shared constant, so the work and the model prompt no longer grow without bound. Six test mocks gained a limit step on the query chain (disclosed; behaviour unchanged). Verified later: the topic graph, propagation map, resilience index and succession analyzer each read at most INTERVIEW_READ_LIMIT (500) published interviews, which also bounds the succession prompt and the tag pairs.

DEF-0B7-COGB-NARRATIVES-CITE-ZERO-EVIDEN.explanation: A narrative whose envelope carries no evidence now says that no institutional evidence is attached and that the result is guidance, not a finding, instead of "Derived from 0 institutional evidence items".
DEF-0B7-COGB-NARRATIVES-CITE-ZERO-EVIDEN.remaining: The headline is still the first sentence of fixed interpretation guidance and the engines still emit no evidence, reasoning or implications.

DEF-0B7-COGA-EMPTY-ORGANIZATION-RESILIEN.explanation: Existing implementation, verified: the resilience index refuses an organization with no dependency data with a conflict instead of computing NaN scores, so no strong status or brief is derived from it; an existing test covers both the empty and the interviews-without-nodes cases.

DEF-0B10-OPL-06.explanation: The organization search always excludes the platform organization type and any organization whose status is not active (a missing status counts as active), with or without a term, matches the term literally (percent and underscore escaped), and orders by name then id. The real-SQL pglite test for the search still passes, and a source-contract test pins the predicates.

DEF-0B9-ASM-ONBOARDING-EVENT-METADATA-IS.explanation: The onboarding event payload bounds targetUserId (255) and role (64), limits metadata to 20 keys of short scalar values, and stores caller metadata before targetUserId and role so it can never replace the values the audit row records.
DEF-0B9-ASM-ONBOARDING-EVENT-METADATA-IS.remaining: The event is still a caller-asserted milestone (tracked by the companion defect).

DEF-0B10-PIL-PUBLIC-APPLICATION-RESPONSE.explanation: The anonymous pilot application bounds responses to 16 KB, 60 keys and 4 levels of nesting, and keeps only a finite numeric or short string assessment score instead of a passthrough object. Unit tests cover each bound.
DEF-0B10-PIL-PUBLIC-APPLICATION-RESPONSE.remaining: The stored responses are still free-form JSON that later reads, proposals and exports consume; no per-key schema exists.

DEF-0B4-OHS-REGULATORY-RECORD-HARD-DELET.explanation: New crud-factory option retainOnDelete: DELETE answers 409 before any lookup or write, so the row is kept. Applied to the anti-scab violation and joint health-and-safety committee item routes, the two tables the defect names. A contract test pins that the refusal comes before any audited write or tx.delete.

DEF-0B5-OHS-REFUSAL-EVENT-HARD-DELETE.explanation: The right-of-refusal item route declares retainOnDelete, so the refusal record and any reprisal complaint are never removed through the generic delete (409).
DEF-0B5-OHS-REFUSAL-EVENT-HARD-DELETE.remaining: No retention rule is named by a source, so the record is retained rather than archived; a governed withdrawal action is still to be defined.

DEF-0B7-PLT-EXT-DELETE-HARD-DELETE-CASCA.explanation: Deleting an integration first confirms it belongs to the organization (404 otherwise), then refuses with 409 when any synchronization history exists, so the cascade can never erase it; the integration is disabled instead. The existing extensions test was adapted to the new query sequence and gained the history case (disclosed).

DEF-0B11-SOC-ANALYTICS-EXPORT-IS-A-DELET.explanation: The social analytics export no longer executes on DELETE: that verb returns 405, while GET ?export=true is separately steward-gated. The export rejects invalid format/date windows and refuses oversized results rather than silently truncating them; CSV remains formula-neutralized and account follower columns now map correctly. A mandatory tenant-bound audit is persisted before any CSV/JSON response; audit failures return 503 without exporting data. Both response types prohibit caching. Source and regression tests are committed but executable and runtime qualification are pending.
DEF-0B11-SOC-ANALYTICS-EXPORT-IS-A-DELET.remaining: Exact-HEAD focused and full Vitest/contract, native PostgreSQL 15/16 with real RLS and audit storage, HTTP/browser/staging acceptance, and institutional decision on export audience remain outstanding. Campaign export still uses bounded per-campaign queries and needs scalable server-side aggregation; no production acceptance claimed.

DEF-0B11-SOC-RECORD-IS-LOADED-BY-ID-ALON.explanation: The post delete and the campaign analytics lookups name the caller organization inside the query (the post through an inner join to its account), so another organization row is simply not found (404) and the 403-versus-404 existence oracle is gone. The campaign routes already did this. The post delete test mock gained the inner join and now expects 404 for a foreign post (disclosed).

DEF-0B7-PLT-SSO-CREATE-STORES-UNVALIDATE.explanation: Migration 0038 adds unique partial indexes (organization and SAML entity id; organization, OIDC issuer and client id), refusing to apply over duplicates; a duplicate create answers 409. The create now accepts requireGroups (at most 50 short names). Proven on PGlite.
DEF-0B7-PLT-SSO-CREATE-STORES-UNVALIDATE.remaining: No proof that the organization owns the identity domain: that needs a DNS or e-mail verification process with the identity provider, which a schema cannot supply.

DEF-0B4-CALENDAR-TOKEN-PLAINTEXT-FALLBAC.explanation: A provider token is never stored without an encryption key (development included; plaintext only under the test runner), and a stored value with no encryption prefix is refused unless CALENDAR_TOKEN_ALLOW_LEGACY_PLAINTEXT is set for a flagged migration window. New unit tests cover round trip, missing key in development and production, and the legacy flag.
DEF-0B4-CALENDAR-TOKEN-PLAINTEXT-FALLBAC.remaining: Existing plaintext rows need a one-time re-encryption or re-authorization; none is performed here.

DEF-0B7-PLT-ENT-LISTS-EXPIRED-AND-UNBACK.explanation: The entitlement list now names only the feature keys that the server-side checkModuleEntitlement allows (not expired, backing contract active) and is limited to 200 rows. Contract test pins the check.

DEF-0B6-EDU-SESSION-COURSE-ID-NOT-VERIFI.explanation: The training session create checks that the course is the organization own (shared reference helper, 404 otherwise) and accepts only an allow-list of descriptive fields: registration, waitlist, attendance, completion, rating, evaluation, cost, status and cancellation figures are no longer body-writable. Contract test pins the allow-list and the check.

DEF-0B6-EMP-COMMUNICATION-REFERENCES-UNV.explanation: Logging an employer communication checks employerId, grievanceId, recipientContactId and templateId against the caller organization before any write (404, nothing written or audited), and the list is limited to 200. The existing route test mock gained the limit step and a new test covers a foreign grievance (disclosed).

DEF-0B5-SMS-ROWS-WRITTEN-WITHOUT-SENDING.explanation: The SMS message, campaign and conversation collections keep their officer-floor read, and their POST (which inserted rows carrying status, provider id, price and delivery times for messages never sent) now answers 501 and writes nothing. Contract test pins the read and the refusal.

DEF-0B5-SMS-READ-ROUTE-IS-GENERIC-MESSAG.explanation: The conversation read path no longer lists every message of the organization or inserts a message row: both methods answer 501 at the officer floor. The F07 read-authority contract test listed this path among the CRUD floors and was adjusted to drop it (disclosed); the new test pins the 501.

DEF-0B5-COMMS-TEMPLATE-HARD-DELETE.explanation: No schema change was needed: the tables already carry is_active. The shared CRUD factory gains archiveColumn, so DELETE archives the template (is_active false, audited) instead of removing it, and the collections list active templates only. The B53 retain-on-delete pin was replaced by an archive pin (disclosed).

DEF-0B5-COMMS-LIST-DELETE-ERASES-SUBSCRI.explanation: DELETE of a distribution list now archives it (is_active false), so the cascade that erased the subscribed, unsubscribed and unsubscribe-reason trail can no longer fire through the API; the collection lists active lists only.

DEF-0B4-BATCH-STATUS-FABRICATED-PROCESSI.explanation: A job id that is not a campaign job, or a campaign of another organization, is answered 404 instead of a fabricated processing status with a start time of now; the failed-recipient list names a recipient id, not an e-mail address.

DEF-0B10-ORG-NLRB-AND-LABOUR-BOARD-FILIN.explanation: Existing implementation, verified by a new source-contract test: both filing paths answer 501 and neither is the generic campaign CRUD any more.

DEF-0B10-ORG-FORM-GENERATION-ROUTE-RETUR.explanation: The generation endpoint already refuses unsupported work with 501. The client now checks HTTP success, application/pdf content type, PDF magic bytes, and a 20 MB safety ceiling before creating a downloadable file. A 501 or JSON success-looking response produces an accessible visible error instead of a mislabeled PDF. Template selection now fills the selected template, and the federal information link no longer falsely advertises electronic filing. Focused regression tests are committed but not executed on this HEAD.
DEF-0B10-ORG-FORM-GENERATION-ROUTE-RETUR.remaining: A real jurisdiction-specific PDF generator, template authority/legal review, PDF content validation, and exact-HEAD unit, native PostgreSQL, HTTP/browser and staging acceptance remain outstanding; the client explicitly preserves entered values on refusal.

DEF-0B8-JUR-MEETING-ROOM-BOOKINGS-PATH-I.explanation: The bookings path serves bookings (GET slots with details only for the caller's own bookings unless staff; POST; PATCH approve or decline; DELETE cancels and keeps the row), each scoped to the caller's organization, audited in the same transaction; a booking id of another organization or room is not found. The f12-b53 contract pin that listed this route as 501 was removed (disclosed).

DEF-0B4-CARBON-ORG-ID-FROM-QUERY-STRING.explanation: Existing implementation, verified: the carbon dashboard no longer reads an organization id from the query string and no longer returns figures; it answers 501.

DEF-0B5-SURVEY-RESPONSES-ROUTE-IGNORES-S.explanation: Existing implementation, verified: the response create verifies the survey belongs to the caller organization, is active and open, and strips respondent identity for an anonymous survey; the list is a count-only steward read of the path survey.
DEF-0B5-SURVEY-RESPONSES-ROUTE-IGNORES-S.remaining: The POST still takes the survey id from the body rather than the path.

DEF-0B12-PLT-KPI-HEALTH-TREATS-A-LOWER-F.explanation: Migration 0038 adds kpi_configurations.direction (higher_is_better or lower_is_better, null for rows that predate it). A target can be created with a direction, and the summary lets a stored direction decide; only a target with none keeps the threshold-order inference. Proven on PGlite (check constraint) and by unit tests.

DEF-0B3-TENTATIVE-AGREEMENT-REFERENCES-U.explanation: relatedProposalIds are now an array of at most 50 ids, each of which must be a proposal of the same negotiation, and relatedClauseId must be a clause of an agreement of the caller organization (404 otherwise, nothing written). Existing route tests pass.

DEF-0B4-OHS-FILINGS-OWNER-FILTER-INCONSI.explanation: The filings collection sets staffReadsAll, so the member-id owner scope applies only below the steward floor and a steward reads the organization filings, as the item routes already allow.

DEF-0B6-CMP-LEADERSHIP-COMPLIANCE-DEFAUL.explanation: Deadline adherence and documentation rate are null, not 100, when there is nothing to measure, and the card shows a dash in a neutral colour. The empty-input service test pinned the 100 and was changed to expect null (disclosed).
DEF-0B6-CMP-LEADERSHIP-COMPLIANCE-DEFAUL.remaining: No code inserts compliance alerts, and the grievance aggregates still stop at the first 5000 rows.

DEF-0B8-HS-UNMEASURED-VALUES-COERCED-TO-.explanation: The inspection findings list reports a missing score as null (shown as a dash) instead of 0%. The statistics and dashboard routes already reported unmeasured values as null (existing implementation, existing tests pass).

DEF-0B6-EMP-CONTACT-PRIMARY-NOT-EXCLUSIV.explanation: Migration 0038 adds a partial unique index so an employer has at most one active primary contact; it refuses to apply over an employer that already has two. The create keeps its in-transaction demotion and answers a lost race with 409. Proven on PGlite, including the refusal over existing duplicates.

DEF-0B5-OHS-OWNER-COLUMN-WORKERID-ABSENT.explanation: Existing implementation, verified by a new test: neither collection declares an owner column the table lacks, so no declared-but-unapplied owner condition remains.

DEF-0B4-CALENDAR-EVENT-CALENDAR-ID-UNVER.explanation: Existing implementation, verified: the event update schema is strict and does not accept calendarId, so an update cannot re-point an event at another calendar; creation already checks the calendar belongs to the organization and is not another member's personal calendar. Pinned by a test.

DEF-0B5-COMMITTEE-DECISIONS-EDITABLE-AFT.explanation: A meeting update that touches decisions, agenda items, agenda or status is conditional on the minutes not yet being approved; when they are, the update answers 409 (404 only for a missing meeting). Other fields (location, link) stay editable. Existing committee tests pass; a source-contract test pins the predicate.

DEF-0B5-COMMITTEE-MINUTES-NO-SEPARATION-.explanation: Migration 0038 adds committee_meetings.minutes_recorded_by and a check that the approver is not the recorder. Recording the minutes stores the recorder and approval refuses that person (403); a meeting recorded before the column existed falls back to its last editor.

DEF-0B5-COMMITTEE-REFERENCED-IDS-NOT-VER.explanation: A linked fileUrl must be a pointer into the organization's own document storage (verifiedLegacyBlobPath: configured storage account, document container, the organization's folder, no credential, no traversal) or the link is refused with 400. Tested with an own URL, another host, another organization's folder, a credential, a traversal and a metadata address.

DEF-0B7-EXC-SEPARATION-OF-DUTIES-ONLY-AG.explanation: Migration 0038 adds exit_interviews.submitted_by and a check that the reviewer is not the submitter. Submitting stores the submitter and review refuses that person (403), with the last-editor fallback only for earlier rows. Existing review tests pass.

DEF-0B7-EXC-DOCUMENTS-ATTACHABLE-AFTER-R.explanation: Documents and transcripts can no longer be attached to an interview that is reviewed, published or archived (409), so what the reviewer approved is what is published.

DEF-0B5-UNSUBSCRIBE-WRITES-NOT-ATOMIC.explanation: The message log, campaign stats, preference, list subscriptions and consent record are written on the one transaction handed to the callback (they used the shared connection, so there was no transaction at all). The unit-test mocks were adapted to pass the mock db as the transaction and to include the newsletter tables, and the real-SQL pglite test now creates those tables and still passes (disclosed).
DEF-0B5-UNSUBSCRIBE-WRITES-NOT-ATOMIC.remaining: The public GET still changes state; it is guarded by a signed, action-bound token.

DEF-0B5-UNSUBSCRIBE-LEAVES-LIST-SUBSCRIP.explanation: A campaign-link unsubscribe also marks the recipient subscriptions to the distribution lists of that organization unsubscribed, in the same transaction. Proven on real SQL (pglite) not to fail; contract test pins the update.

DEF-0B6-EDU-CONTENT-PUBLISH-NO-SEPARATIO.explanation: Migration 0038 adds cms_pages.submitted_by. Moving an item to review records who did it, and publication is refused for that person, with the last-editor fallback only for earlier rows. Existing status tests pass.

DEF-0B6-EDU-REGISTRATION-NO-CAPACITY-DUP.explanation: Migration 0040 adds a unique index (organization, member, session) that refuses to apply over existing duplicates, and a BEFORE INSERT/UPDATE trigger that locks the session row and refuses a registration beyond max_enrollment (SQLSTATE 23514); a cancelled place frees a seat and a re-save of a registered row is not recounted. The CRUD factory gains mapCreateError so a lost race answers 409 (full, or already registered). Proven on PGlite.

DEF-0B1-CLC-PUBLIC-CACHE-CONTROL.explanation: Existing implementation, verified: the four administrator-only CLC analytics routes answer Cache-Control private, no-store; pinned by a test that also refuses any public value.

DEF-0B5-COMMITTEE-LIST-PAGINATION-UNBOUN.explanation: The meeting list takes a bounded limit (1..200, default 50) and offset (0..1,000,000) and the intelligence list a bounded limit (1..100, default 20) through listPage; a non-numeric or negative value is the default and NaN never reaches the query.

DEF-0B6-EDU-CONTENT-LISTS-UNBOUNDED-OR-U.explanation: Both content lists take a bounded limit (1..200; training default 200, templates default 50) and offset through listPage, ordered with the id as a tie-break so a page is stable; a negative or non-numeric limit is the default instead of a SQL error.

DEF-0B8-ICRA-READ-ROUTES-HAVE-NO-LIMITER.explanation: The resume, profile and PDF report reads now pass through guardPublicIntake with the capability bucket before any lookup or render; a limited caller gets 429 (503 when the limiter is unavailable in production). The report route test mocks the guard and gained a test that a limited caller triggers no lookup and no render (disclosed).

DEF-0B8-JUR-GEOFENCE-CREATE-BODY-IS-UNVA.explanation: The body is parsed as JSON (400 otherwise) and validated: a trimmed bounded name and description, a type from strike_line, union_hall and safety_zone, numeric coordinates in range, a positive radius of at most 10 km; strikeId is refused because no strike register exists to prove it belongs to the organization. The existing tenant, role and audit tests pass.

DEF-0B9-ML-SLA-MODEL-VERSION-IS-CALLER-N.explanation: The prediction accepts only the version the scorer implements (sla-risk-v1), so a steward can no longer create a model row for any typed string; the version stored on the prediction is the model's own, and feedback (S02) only scores an existing model and refuses a mismatched version.

DEF-0B9-ORG-ITEM-PATCH-BODY-UNVALIDATED-.explanation: The update body is parsed (400 on malformed JSON) and validated by a strict schema: bounded name, lowercase slug format, e-mail, http(s) website, bounded sectors, a guid parent and a settings object of at most 200 keys and 16 KB; unknown keys are refused. A new slug must be free (409, also on the unique-index race) and settings are merged key by key instead of replacing the stored ones.

DEF-0B2-AGREEMENTS-BODY-UNVALIDATED.explanation: Creation is validated: required typed and bounded fields, jurisdiction and language from the enums, expiry after the effective date, an https document address, numeric coverage; organization, publication and authorship stay server-owned; a duplicate agreement number is 409. The list parses page and limit so NaN never reaches the query. The route tests, which created agreements from a body holding only a title, now send a valid agreement and gained refusal cases (disclosed).

DEF-0B11-PRP-DUES-PAY-GET-RETURNS-EVERY-.explanation: The payment history lists payments only (not charges, credits, adjustments or write-offs), omits the processor payment reference, and pages through a bounded limit and offset with a stable order; a non-numeric limit is the default.
DEF-0B11-PRP-DUES-PAY-GET-RETURNS-EVERY-.remaining: Pending payment attempts created by POST are still not listed: they live in dues_transactions and need a joined, status-filtered read.

DEF-0B6-EDU-CONTENT-COMPLETIONS-COUNT-AT.explanation: The training list and the content statistics count a completion as a registration with completed true, no longer as attended true, so a member who attended without finishing is not counted as having completed the course.

DEF-0B2-AI-INVOCATION-NOT-AUDITED.explanation: Existing implementation, verified: the classify, summarize, match-precedents and search routes now run the model call inside performAuditedOperation, which records intent and outcome and answers a refused audit through operationAuditResponse; pinned by a test. The intent and outcome are separate transactions from the effect (a different, still open defect).

DEF-0B8-JUR-LOCATION-CONSENT-GET-EXPIRES.explanation: A consent check is a read and no longer writes: past its expiry the consent is simply not valid, whatever its stored status. The existing geofence service and route tests pass.
DEF-0B8-JUR-LOCATION-CONSENT-GET-EXPIRES.remaining: The stored status of an expired consent never becomes expired: a sweep needs the system role to hold UPDATE on member_location_consent, which the storage-authority manifest and the location-retention ratchets do not grant (an attempt broke them and was reverted).

DEF-0B7-EXP-REPORT-DEFINITIONS-READABLE-.explanation: The report reads already sit at the steward floor (upstream); a definition its author kept private (isPublic false) is now read by its author only, through the new factory option readConditionFor (applied to every list and item GET), so another steward no longer receives it with its whole config.

DEF-0B11-IDS-SUPPORT-READ-GIVES-EVERY-ST.explanation: Existing implementation, verified: both paths answer 501 and no longer expose the notifications CRUD, so no steward reads other members' notifications through them.

DEF-0B11-IDS-SECURITY-EVENTS-ROUTE-IS-CO.explanation: The path now answers 501 behind the security-manager floor and reads and writes nothing. It was configured as a reader and a writer of security evidence while the governance list denied both, so the comment and the behaviour disagreed and a write path for security events existed only on paper; security events are read on the security dashboard and written by the system.

DEF-0B4-CBAS-CBA-NUMBER-GLOBALLY-UNIQUE.explanation: Migration 0042 replaces the single-column unique constraint on collective_agreements.cba_number with a unique index on (organization_id, cba_number): two organizations may use one agreement number and a repeat inside one is refused, so a number taken elsewhere is no longer disclosed by a refusal. Proved on PGlite, including a standalone unique index form, idempotency, refusal over existing in-organization duplicates, fail-closed on a missing organization_id, and a rollback that refuses when two organizations share a code.

DEF-0B6-EDU-GLOBAL-UNIQUE-CODES-ACROSS-O.explanation: Migration 0042 makes course_code, session_code and certification_number unique within an organization instead of across all of them, so one organization's code no longer blocks another's.

DEF-0B8-HS-RECORD-NUMBERS-CALLER-SUPPLIE.explanation: Migration 0042 makes incident_number, inspection_number, report_number and item_number unique within an organization.
DEF-0B8-HS-RECORD-NUMBERS-CALLER-SUPPLIE.remaining: The numbers are still supplied by the caller; a server-issued per-organization sequence is not built.

DEF-0B10-ORG-CAMPAIGN-CODE-UNIQUE-ACROSS.explanation: Migration 0042 makes organizing_campaigns.campaign_code unique within an organization.
DEF-0B10-ORG-CAMPAIGN-CODE-UNIQUE-ACROSS.remaining: campaign_code and the other columns are still required in the body; a server-issued code and defaults are not built.

DEF-0B6-SYS-LOCATION-DELETION-LOG-FABRIC.explanation: The deletion log records the real oldest and newest dates of the rows it deleted (read from the deleted rows, tracking recorded_at and event time) instead of the run time for both. The retention owner PGlite test's stub tables gained recorded_at and event_time and it now asserts the span (disclosed).
DEF-0B6-SYS-LOCATION-DELETION-LOG-FABRIC.remaining: The log has no organization column, so a run that deleted several organizations' rows is still one undifferentiated entry; that needs a column and a per-organization entry.

DEF-0B9-ORG-DIRECTORY-PROJECTION-FILLS-M.explanation: Existing implementation, verified: the member directory projections no longer substitute a department or a position; pinned by a test.

DEF-0B12-PLT-ORGANIZATIONS-LEGACY-BRANCH.explanation: Existing implementation, verified: the organizations list no longer has the platform-administrator-id legacy branch and does not read or log the caller's e-mail address; pinned by a test.

DEF-0B11-RPT-SCHEDULED-PATHS-ARE-REPORT-.explanation: The scheduled-report paths no longer expose report-definition CRUD as though it were a schedule. Existing implementation, verified: the path answers 501 behind its role floor and reads and writes nothing; pinned by a test.

DEF-0B10-ORG-ORGANIZER-TASK-CREATE-STORE.explanation: The organizer-impact path no longer creates organizer tasks with unverified assignee, member, case and grievance references. Existing implementation, verified: the path answers 501 behind its role floor and reads and writes nothing; pinned by a test.

DEF-0B10-ORG-ORGANIZER-TASKS-READABLE-BY.explanation: The organizer-impact path no longer returns every organizer task of the organization to any steward. Existing implementation, verified: the path answers 501 behind its role floor and reads and writes nothing; pinned by a test.

DEF-0B11-RPT-BUILDER-AND-DATA-SOURCE-SAM.explanation: The report-builder and data-source-sample paths no longer act as report-definition CRUD. Existing implementation, verified: the path answers 501 behind its role floor and reads and writes nothing; pinned by a test.

DEF-0B7-EXC-COPILOT-CONVERSATIONS-HAVE-N.explanation: Migration 0043 adds created_by to ue_copilot_conversations (nullable; rows that predate it have no owner and so are visible to nobody, nothing is backfilled). A conversation is created with its opener, listed and read only for that opener, and appended to only by that opener; naming a conversation that is not yours answers not found with no model call. The engine tests (signature and ownership) were updated and extended (disclosed).

DEF-0B7-EXC-REASONING-SESSIONS-HAVE-NO-O.explanation: Migration 0043 adds created_by to ue_reasoning_sessions. A session records its creator; the route lists only the caller's sessions, and get, update, annotate, link and simulate are held to the creator in the SQL. The organization-wide list remains for the continuity engines that aggregate sessions into figures and show none to anyone.

DEF-0B7-EXC-COPILOT-CONTEXT-IS-CLIENT-SU.explanation: The model input is built from the caller's stored conversation (the last 20 messages); prior messages sent by the client are accepted for compatibility and ignored, so a caller cannot put words in the assistant's mouth or pass instructions as earlier turns. Tested with a forged assistant turn.

DEF-0B4-OHS-ANTI-SCAB-RECORD-NO-AUTHOR-O.explanation: Migration 0044 adds created_by (text, nullable; the existing reported_by_id is a uuid and could not hold a session principal) to anti_scab_violations. The factory stamps the session user as the author on create; the collection route no longer accepts the reporter, a resolution, a penalty or a tribunal filing from the body, and the item route refuses to patch the author or the reporter. Proved on PGlite for the migration and by source pins.
DEF-0B4-OHS-ANTI-SCAB-RECORD-NO-AUTHOR-O.remaining: Any steward of the organization still reads and rewrites every violation: case authority (the steward represents the member the matter concerns) needs a kernel resource type for these records.

DEF-0B8-FED-LOCALS-DELETE-ARCHIVES-STATU.explanation: Existing implementation, verified: the locals paths answer 501 and no longer delete or archive bargaining units under a local-union name; pinned by a test.

DEF-0B7-PLT-EQUITY-SELF-IDENTIFY-WRITE-F.explanation: Existing implementation, verified: the self-identification path answers 501, so it no longer accepts a steward-entered self-identification that the data subject could not make; pinned by a test.

DEF-0B11-SOC-DISCONNECT-DELETES-THE-CRED.explanation: The local credential is still removed (an unremovable credential would be worse), but the revocation outcome (revoked, not required, failed) is recorded in the audit entry and returned, and a failed revocation is answered with a message that the platform token stays valid until it expires or is revoked at the platform instead of a plain success. The existing social-media route tests pass.

DEF-0B8-HS-TRAINING-FIGURES-READ-A-TABLE.explanation: No route or job writes training records, so an organization with none now gets trainingDue null (not measured) with trainingRecordsHeld 0, instead of "0 due"; the training page shows the records held as its total rather than the due count.

DEF-0B10-PEN-PENSION-WRITES-STORE-TYPED-.explanation: A contribution and a benefit claim are recorded only against a pension member of the caller's organization (404 otherwise), under the stored member name (the typed name is ignored), with a positive amount of at most ten digits and two decimals; a member is enrolled only in a plan of the organization, under that plan's own name, with a bounded years-of-service figure. The own-records route test mock was extended for the member lookup and gained refusal cases (disclosed).
DEF-0B10-PEN-PENSION-WRITES-STORE-TYPED-.remaining: The trustee and plan write routes still store typed names and figures (plan figures are administrator-typed and readable by any member, a separate open defect), and the T4A route is not implemented.

DEF-0B4-BATCH-STATUS-FINANCE-ENTITLEMENT.explanation: The finance-suite entitlement no longer gates a newsletter campaign's progress (it admitted a union that bought finance but not communications and refused the reverse); the steward floor and the caller's-organization campaign scope remain. No communications entitlement exists in the catalogue, so none is substituted; adding one is a product decision.

DEF-0B4-BATCH-STATUS-RECIPIENT-EMAILS-DI.explanation: Existing implementation, verified: the status response lists no recipient address (earlier B53 work); pinned by a test, so there is no disclosure to audit.

DEF-0B5-COMMS-ACTION-ROUTE-IS-GENERIC-CA.explanation: The analytics path, the last of the three (schedule and send-test were already 501), no longer returns the campaign row as analytics, updates it without validation, or archives the campaign on DELETE: it answers 501 and reads and writes nothing; pinned by a test.

DEF-0B5-POLLS-NO-CREATE-OR-VOTE-PATH.explanation: The vote path answered a misleading 403 for every caller because poll_votes is denied in the CRUD governance table; it now answers 501 honestly and the governance entries for poll_votes and security_events were removed because no generic route uses them any more (a table not listed is still DENIED; the ratchet test pin was adjusted, disclosed).
DEF-0B5-POLLS-NO-CREATE-OR-VOTE-PATH.remaining: No route creates a poll or records a vote: the polls collection route is generic CRUD over a read-only table, and a real create-and-vote path with one-vote-per-member enforcement is not built.

DEF-0B12-PLT-VOCABULARY-LAST-UPDATED-IS-.explanation: lastUpdated is a fixed revision date and a contentDigest (a pure FNV-1a over every entry) changes whenever any entry changes, so the vocabulary no longer reports now and a constant on every call.

DEF-0B12-PLT-V2-CATCH-ALL-SUNSET-DATE-IS.explanation: The v2 catch-all answers 410 Gone for every method (it never answers 200), the Sunset header is no longer advertised once the date has passed, and the registry route reports sunsetPassed computed from the clock through one shared helper instead of a typed string.

DEF-0B12-PLT-TRIAGE-REVOKE-CARRIES-THE-D.explanation: DELETE takes the designation id from the query string; a body of at most 1 KB is still honoured for existing callers, and an invalid id is a 400.

DEF-0B8-JUR-RULES-ROUTE-ACCEPTS-ANY-CODE.explanation: The code is looked up with an own-key test, so constructor and __proto__ no longer select a function; an unknown code or an unknown category is a 400 instead of success with an empty list. The deadline-separation test now expects the 400 for a category the register does not hold (disclosed).

DEF-0B11-PRP-JURISDICTION-PREFERENCES-HA.explanation: Migration 0046 adds a unique index on (user_id, organization_id) (fail-closed on existing duplicates); the route upserts against it, so two concurrent first saves settle on one row, and includeNational and autoApply must be booleans. The route test mock gained onConflictDoUpdate (disclosed).
DEF-0B11-PRP-JURISDICTION-PREFERENCES-HA.remaining: No precedent route reads the saved preference, so it still filters nothing on the server; applying it server-side is a product decision.

DEF-0B6-EMP-REGISTRY-PARENT-COMPANY-CROS.explanation: The create and update hooks require parentCompanyId to be an employer of the caller organization (and not the employer itself); migration 0046 adds a trigger that refuses a parent of another organization or itself with SQLSTATE 23514, mapped to a 400.

DEF-0B7-EXP-EXTERNAL-DOWNLOAD-RELEASES-L.explanation: external_document_access_grants gains a nullable document_version_no (migration 0046). The authorization decision carries it, the download releases exactly that version, and an upload-created grant is pinned to the version it stored.
DEF-0B7-EXP-EXTERNAL-DOWNLOAD-RELEASES-L.remaining: Grants issued before the migration carry no pin and keep releasing the current version; pinning them needs a reviewed backfill of what each grant covered.

DEF-0B8-FED-EXTERNAL-GRIEVANCE-PROJECTIO.explanation: The route selects only the projected columns under the names the grievances table really has (grievance_number as the case number, description as the summary), so the case number and summary are no longer always null and no other column is read.

DEF-0B7-EXP-REPORT-HARD-DELETE-AUDIT-NAM.explanation: The factory gains hardDeleteAuditColumns; the report delete audit now keeps the name, type, category, visibility and author of the removed definition.

DEF-0B11-PRP-PRECEDENT-ITEM-DELETE-HARD-.explanation: A precedent with citation history is retained (409, withdraw its sharing instead) so the cascade can no longer destroy it; an uncited one is removed with an audit that keeps its case title, jurisdiction, sharing level and removed tag count. The PGlite test gained the tag and citation tables and two cases (disclosed).

DEF-0B8-HS-STATS-ORGANIZATION-FILTER-FAL.explanation: Every aggregate refuses with a 400 when there is no organization instead of falling back to an always-true predicate; verified in source and pinned.

DEF-0B8-HS-LIST-ROUTES-IGNORE-FILTERS-TH.explanation: The factory gains listFilters (enum-checked equality filters and an escaped, bounded text search); the incident list honours status, severity, incidentType and search, and the hazard list status, priority (the hazard level) and search.

DEF-0B7-COGA-FEDERATED-PERCENTILE-FROM-U.explanation: The unsourced percentile table and cohort averages are removed. The result keeps the score bands as a rubric the product defines, reports no percentile (null) and no cohort average, compares each dimension with the midpoint of its own band, and states referenceStatus UNSOURCED_RUBRIC_NO_POPULATION; the screen no longer shows a percentile. The federated-engine test was rewritten for the new fields (disclosed).

DEF-0B7-EXC-MITIGATION-PROJECTIONS-ARE-F.explanation: The per-domain confidence is always unvalidated (no band is claimed from the constant), the comparison states basis ASSUMED_EFFECTIVENESS_NOT_CALIBRATED with the assumptions listed, the rationale says it is under those assumptions, and a run in which no scenario reached any node reports noNodesEvaluated, recommends nothing and says so instead of ranking zeroes.

DEF-0B7-COGB-AGGREGATE-ERRORS-RETURNED-V.explanation: Both aggregators report a failed engine by engine, domain and a fixed code (NOT_IMPLEMENTED or ENGINE_FAILED) and never the exception text, state complete false when any engine is missing, and answer 503 when every engine failed. The route test mocks the limiter backend and gained four cases (disclosed).

DEF-0B7-COGB-AGGREGATE-RUNS-28-ENGINES-P.explanation: A run is limited to 12 per minute per organization (shared limiter, refusing when it is unavailable), and a result without failures is reused for 30 seconds from a bounded memo keyed by organization, never shared across organizations.

DEF-0B7-COGB-SUCCESSION-CALL-NOT-AUDITED.explanation: Verified in source: the analyzer writes requested, completed and failed audit records through persistAtomicAudit naming the acting user; the route now also limits model runs to 10 per hour per organization.

DEF-0B7-COGB-SUCCESSION-MODEL-OUTPUT-UNV.explanation: Verified in source: the reply is parsed against a zod schema, an unusable reply is audited and answers an error instead of a canned 200 summary, and the report carries modelGenerated.

DEF-0B3-AUDITS-FABRICATED-ENGAGEMENT-FIE.explanation: The list states kind audit_log_entries, no longer invents a findings count of 0 or a hasReport flag, and a non-successful entry is unknown instead of an engagement in progress.

DEF-0B6-EMP-COMMUNICATION-NOT-DELIVERED.explanation: The route is stated and answered as recorded only (delivery recorded_only): the sender is no longer the invented System, sentAt is the recorder-stated occurredAt (never in the future) and is no longer stamped by the server. The route test gained cases (disclosed).

DEF-0B6-EMP-CAPE-AUDIT-EVENT-AFTER-COMMI.explanation: The second audit event emitted after the commit (which also carried the contact name) is removed from both routes; the in-transaction audit record is the only one.

DEF-0B7-EXP-EXTERNAL-DOWNLOAD-BEARER-LIN.explanation: The link lives five minutes instead of sixty, its lifetime is returned and recorded in the audit.
DEF-0B7-EXP-EXTERNAL-DOWNLOAD-BEARER-LIN.remaining: A storage link is still a read-only bearer URL for those minutes and cannot be bound to the caller or recalled when the grant is revoked.

DEF-0B4-CLAUSE-LIBRARY-EDIT-AND-DELETE-N.explanation: A change to the title, text or type raises the version and the audit records the versions and a SHA-256 of the replaced text; a clause shared beyond private is refused deletion (409) until withdrawn from sharing, and the delete audit keeps its title, type, version and text digest.
DEF-0B4-CLAUSE-LIBRARY-EDIT-AND-DELETE-N.remaining: The replaced text itself is not retained as a prior row (previous_version_id is unused); only its digest is.

DEF-0B6-SYS-CALENDAR-SYNC-SWALLOWED-EVEN.explanation: The Google import already counted failures and threw; the Microsoft import now counts a failed event, no longer counts a failed cancellation as deleted (the handler throws), stores the delta link only when every event was applied, throws MicrosoftCalendarImportError otherwise, and a failed delta-link write is no longer swallowed.

DEF-0B8-ICRA-CLAIM-BINDS-TO-ANY-SIGNED-I.explanation: Claiming now requires an organization administrator in addition to the token and a membership; a member is refused before anything is written or audited. The claim test gained a case and a mock (disclosed).
DEF-0B8-ICRA-CLAIM-BINDS-TO-ANY-SIGNED-I.remaining: The claim still clears only the claim token: the pseudonymous capability token hash and expiry stay valid, and nothing checks that the claiming organization is the purchaser.

DEF-0B6-SYS-OBSERVABILITY-SWEEP-NO-DEDUP.explanation: Verified in source: an alert is keyed per organization, signal and clock hour, inserted with conflict-do-nothing, and an hour in which every recipient already holds it adds no execution, tracking row or audit entry.

DEF-0B8-ICRA-EVENT-SINK-WRITES-A-TABLE-N.explanation: The sink no longer inserts into an icra_events table that nothing defines inside a try that swallowed every error; each event is a structured log record (kind, ids, hashed address, no personal identifier). Persisting events again needs its own reviewed table and retention.

DEF-0B8-FED-FEDERATION-WRITES-REFUSED-NO.explanation: The federation routes export only the read, matching the READ_ONLY governance class, so a write is a 405 instead of a configured steward write that always answered 403.

DEF-0B8-FED-FLAGS-TYPE-VOCABULARY-ORGANI.explanation: The evaluator handles the documented organization flag type as well as the earlier tenant spelling, so an organization flag is no longer answered disabled as an unknown type.

DEF-0B9-ML-SLA-FEEDBACK-PILOT-EVENT-IS-A.explanation: The pilot event after the committed feedback is caught and logged, so a telemetry failure no longer turns a recorded result into an error response.

DEF-0B9-ORG-ORGANIZATION-ROW-FACADES-CON.explanation: Verified in source: both routes are explicit admin reads that answer 501 for their own organization and 403 otherwise, with no generic organizations write configured.

DEF-0B10-PEN-RETIREMENT-ELIGIBILITY-IS-A.explanation: The threshold is required (the silent default of 25 is removed), the route is described as a years-of-service filter and the answer says it is not an eligibility determination. The PGlite test now passes the threshold and gained a required-threshold case (disclosed).

DEF-0B10-OPL-11.explanation: The platform organization id is answered from the organizations table, and a deployment where that row was never provisioned is a 404 instead of a constant the table does not back.

DEF-0B11-IDS-STEWARD-ROUTES-ARE-CONFIGUR.explanation: Verified in source: the steward routes expose only the directory read (a member-safe projection, the full audited rows for an officer) and no write is configured.
